name: orion_dataset_compare
description: Compare two supplied flat record snapshots by a unique key. Return exact added, removed, changed and unchanged row counts, field changes and up to 20 examples per category containing IDs and field names only. Read-only calculation; reads no files and calls no services.

before.description: Supplied flat JSON records; may also be a JSON-encoded array. No file paths. Up to 512 rows, 32 distinct fields across both snapshots and 256 KiB combined JSON.

after.description: Supplied flat JSON records; may also be a JSON-encoded array. No file paths. Up to 512 rows, 32 distinct fields across both snapshots and 256 KiB combined JSON.

key.description: Unique nonempty string or exact integer ID field in every row; defaults to id. String and integer IDs are distinct.
